About GeneMaps

What is GeneMaps?

A website that turns a Global25 sample into a genetic proximity heatmap against every reference population in a region.

What is G25?

Global25 (G25) uses PCA to compress genome-wide SNP data into 25 coordinates per population. The distance between two G25 vectors approximates genetic distance — what this site turns into a heatmap.

Where does the data come from?

Moriopoulos Collection, Keltyse's ancient averages dataset, and other community-compiled sources — all built from public ancient and modern DNA studies. Some populations are modeled/estimated ("sims"), not genotyped samples.
